lines: Commits: e360683 feat(email): email the client when growth changes their value; 06c3261 test(sip-early-exit): count only the early-exit email after growth; c406c9d fix(email): say the growth email's value is now, and filter by it (review N1, N2, N4, N5). Not pushed, not landed.

Write paths: POST /v1/admin/client-growth/individual (one investor, amount or rate) and POST /v1/admin/client-growth/collective (rate, or explicit items). The Monthly value update sheet sends items with reasonCode 'monthly' to the collective route. insertGrowthEntry has no other caller. Reversals, payouts, maturity, early exit and recordContribution are untouched.

Files: template src/email/investmentGrowthTemplate.ts (v1, a module in emailTemplates.ts); queue src/domain/email/investmentGrowthMail.ts; guard src/domain/email/investmentGrowthGuard.ts (in runtime/workerComposition.ts); reads src/repositories/clientGrowthMailRepository.ts; migration db/migrations/075_investment_growth_email.sql.

Queued inside runGrowthCommit's execute, after the ledger rows and notices, so it shares the transaction and the idempotency receipt. One email per client per operation and fund: client_value_entries_growth_target_uk allows one growth entry per (batch, user, fund), and the outbox dedup key investment_growth:<batchId>:<userId> mirrors it. Duplicate entries passed in throw (rollback).

Figures: sealed deltaPaise = the value_delta_paise written (signed); sealed valueAfterPaise = sum(value_delta_paise) for that client and fund, read back in the same transaction under the position lock; sealed fullName and fundName (current published version name). Plain payload: template, batchId, fundId, effectiveDate, boundEmailRevision.
Copy (N1): the value line now reads 'Your value in this fund is now <X>.', because X is the recorded value at write time and can include later entries when the update is backdated.

Recipients: only active, untombstoned clients get an email; suspended clients still get the ledger row and the in-app notice. Guard cancels (delivery and outbox 'cancelled', a skip, not a failure): reference missing, user missing, revision changed, not active, tombstoned, growth entry missing or reversed. Erasure cancels queued mail and scrubs recipient and payload (now tested).
Replay: the stored receipt answers before execute, so nothing is queued again. A resend after receipt expiry fails the receipt insert (finding-59) and rolls back, mail included.

N2: investment_growth added to the backend filter enum (adminIdentityRoutes.ts) and contracts AdminEmailTemplateKey; OpenAPI and types regenerated. Request-only, so safe for released apps: they never send the key, and AdminEmailDelivery.templateKey is z.string() in a looseObject in every release.

COORDINATOR (agreed, option a): frontend not touched. The label file emailTemplateLabels.ts exists only on main; please add { value: "investment_growth", label: "Value updated" } after the sip_early_exit row of EMAIL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS in the 0.18.3 release-prep commit after landing. It type-checks against the widened AdminEmailTemplateKey. Frontend check was not run in this lane.

Rule 11: 075 re-adds email_deliveries_template_check with 'investment_growth' (expand-only; every row satisfies it; the previous release runs against it unchanged and never writes the key). No response or notification kind changes; the in-app notice stays client_value_updated with its text.

DEPLOY (N5): DEPLOY.md 'Database rollback semantics' says only active clients get the email; released admin apps show the raw key and cannot filter by it; a newer admin app filtering by it against an earlier backend is refused; API and email worker deploy together (an older worker dead-letters it, finding-26); during an images-only rollback a queued growth email is dead-lettered and growth writes send no email, then or later. release_manager/docs/client-erasure.md names investment_growth (coordinator asked for it).
Coordinator: plans/ was outside my files. Please record in plans/admin-improvements.md that 075 is expand-only and the previous release runs against it.

Write paths found: POST /v1/admin/client-growth/individual (one investor, amount or rate) and POST /v1/admin/client-growth/collective (rate, or explicit items). The admin Monthly value update sheet (ValueUpdateSheetScreen) calls commitAdminCollectiveClientGrowth with items and reasonCode 'monthly', so it is the collective explicit path. insertGrowthEntry has no other caller. Reversal, payouts, maturity, early exit and recordContribution are untouched.

New: template investment_growth v1 (src/email/investmentGrowthTemplate.ts, a module in emailTemplates.ts), queue src/domain/email/investmentGrowthMail.ts, guard src/domain/email/investmentGrowthGuard.ts (registered in runtime/workerComposition.ts), reads src/repositories/clientGrowthMailRepository.ts, migration db/migrations/075_investment_growth_email.sql.

Queued inside runGrowthCommit's execute, after the ledger rows, audit and in-app notices, so it shares the transaction and the idempotency receipt. One email per client per operation and fund: index client_value_entries_growth_target_uk allows one growth entry per (batch, user, fund), and the outbox dedup key investment_growth:<batchId>:<userId> mirrors it. Duplicate entries passed in throw (rollback) rather than mail a wrong figure.

Figures: sealed deltaPaise = the value_delta_paise written (signed); sealed valueAfterPaise = sum(value_delta_paise) for that client and fund, read back in the same transaction; sealed fullName and fundName (current published version name, as the client Value updates screen shows). Plain payload: template, batchId, fundId, effectiveDate, boundEmailRevision.
Queue-time skip (as recordContribution): only active, untombstoned clients get an email; a suspended client still gets the ledger row and the in-app notice.

Guard cancels (delivery and outbox 'cancelled': a skip, not a failure): reference missing, user missing, email revision changed, not active (suspended/closed), tombstoned, growth entry missing or reversed. Erasure already cancels queued mail by user_id and scrubs these outbox rows; the dispatcher checks suppression.

Limits: collective stays capped by MAX_COLLECTIVE_CLIENT_TARGETS (500). Mail adds three batched reads per operation plus outbox, delivery and sealed-payload inserts per emailed client, all DB-only in the same transaction; encryption is local. No other network call.

Replay: the stored receipt answers before execute, so nothing is queued again. A resend after receipt expiry runs execute, fails the receipt insert (finding-59) and rolls the whole transaction back, mail included.

Rule 11: 075 re-adds email_deliveries_template_check with 'investment_growth' (expand-only, every row satisfies it; previous release never writes the key; previous release runs against it unchanged). No response, contract or notification kind changes; in-app stays client_value_updated with its existing text. Admin deliveries list returns templateKey as z.string(), so released admin apps show the raw key 'investment_growth'.

Not widened on purpose: the admin deliveries filter enum (backend adminIdentityRoutes templateKeyEnum and contracts AdminEmailTemplateKey) to keep them in step; filtering by this template needs a later contracts + frontend change.
